_comment: Named shots (as SekiSenshi's preview views): query, seconds of play, camera alpha,beta,radius. tools/shots/view.mjs <name> [HH:MM] [out-dir].

port.script: const s=b.session.sim; const me=s.player(); const p=s.ports[1]; me.body.pos.x=p.ax; me.body.pos.z=p.az; me.body.vel.x=0; me.body.vel.z=0;

wreck.script: const s=b.session.sim; const me=s.player(); const w=b.wrecks()[0]; me.body.pos.x=w.x+12; me.body.pos.z=w.z+26; me.body.vel.x=0; me.body.vel.z=0;

island.script: const s=b.session.sim; const is=s.env.archipelago.islands.filter((i)=>i.kind==='jungle').sort((p,q)=>q.radius-p.radius)[0]; const me=s.player(); me.body.pos.x=is.x; me.body.pos.z=is.z+is.radius*1.2+60; me.body.vel.x=0; me.body.vel.z=0;

island-close.script: const s=b.session.sim; const is=s.env.archipelago.islands.filter((i)=>i.kind==='jungle').sort((p,q)=>q.radius-p.radius)[0]; const me=s.player(); me.body.pos.x=is.x; me.body.pos.z=is.z+is.radius*1.2+60; me.body.vel.x=0; me.body.vel.z=0;
